zh.headline: 把複雜的技術，轉化為看得見的商業成果
zh.subHeadline: 經歷過 300+ 人組織擴張與大型電商架構洗禮；既懂高階戰略協同，也能挽起袖子在第一線寫 Code 解決核心技術痛點。

body.text: 十多年跨國企業技術管理與系統開發經驗。曾帶領 70 人工程團隊完成跨國健康零售 SAP 電商微服務重構，並整合全球 CRM / ERP 與售後自動化流程；組織管理幅度達 300+ 人規模。無論是面對投資人與經營層討論技術戰略，還是與工程師坐在一起 Debug 與做架構 Review，都能無縫切換，把複雜的技術債轉化為穩定、高效的商業產出。
合作項目
1. 年度企業技術顧問（一年期顧問約）
適合需要系統重構、跨系統整合、整理技術債或擴編團隊的企業。以一年期顧問方式，依約定頻率（每週或雙週）參與技術決策與架構檢視、規劃電商與 CRM/ERP 資料串接、檢討雲端成本，並協助面試與培育技術主管。
2. 技術長 / 研發部門負責人（CTO / VP of Engineering）
開放跨國企業、上市櫃公司、零售電商或科技公司的技術管理職缺。負責技術規劃、70–300 人工程團隊管理、大型電商與核心平台改版，提升團隊交付穩定度。
3. 技術盡職調查與系統診斷（Tech Due Diligence）
為投資人與企業提供投資或併購前的第三方技術評估——依標的資料完整度，約 1–2 週交付系統架構、程式碼品質與資安設定檢視報告（屬技術評估，非法律意見）；或針對促銷檔期流量瓶頸、跨系統資料不同步等問題提供改善方案。
主要經歷與線上作品
跨國健康與美容零售集團（帶領 70 人工程團隊）：負責 SAP Commerce Cloud 電商平台與微服務架構改版，整合跨國多幣別結帳、會員與庫存同步流程。
跨國消費性電子品牌（跨系統整合）：串接客服、Salesforce、HubSpot、RingCentral 語音系統與 ERP / RMA 退換貨流程，將跨部門人工傳遞的退換貨處理時間從數天縮短至數分鐘。
180+ GitHub 開源專案與主力線上系統：個人 GitHub 累積超過 180+ 開源專案與實戰工具；並長期維運 5 大主力線上系統，包含 888 StockBot 2.0 股票估值分析、888 StockQuant 時間序列預測平台、888news 科技情報彙整與遠端 MCP 服務、DAVID888 Daily 語音 Podcast，以及 333 奇門遁甲曆法決策網站。
合作方式：一年期企業技術顧問｜正職技術主管 (CTO / VP of Engineering)｜技術盡職調查 (Tech DD)。

en.headline: Turning Complex Technology into Business Results
en.subHeadline: Proven leadership across 300+ person organizations and enterprise e-commerce platforms. Combining high-level strategic alignment with hands-on architecture and code to solve complex engineering challenges.

body.text: Over a decade of enterprise technology leadership and software engineering experience. Led a 70-engineer team refactoring an international SAP Commerce Cloud platform and streamlined cross-border CRM/ERP workflows, with proven management span across 300+ person organizations. Equally comfortable aligning technical strategy with the board and sitting side-by-side with engineers debugging code and reviewing PRs—bridging the gap between business vision and ground-level execution.
Engagement Options
1. Annual Technical Advisor (12-Month Retainer)

For companies planning system refactoring, cross-system integration, technical debt cleanup, or team expansion. I work with leadership on a 12-month retainer to review architecture, connect e-commerce and CRM/ERP data flows, optimize cloud costs, and help interview and mentor engineering leads.
2. CTO / VP of Engineering

Open to full-time technology leadership roles at multinational corporations, listed groups, retail/e-commerce enterprises, and technology companies. Responsible for technical direction, managing 70–300 person engineering teams, and improving platform stability and delivery.
3. Technical Due Diligence & System Review

Independent pre-investment or pre-M&A technical reviews for investors and companies—delivering a 3-pillar report covering architecture, codebase quality, and security/compliance within 2 weeks; or diagnosing traffic bottlenecks and data sync issues.
Experience & Live Systems

International Health & Beauty Retail Group (Led 70 Engineers): Refactored the SAP Commerce Cloud e-commerce platform and microservices architecture across multi-currency checkout, loyalty, and inventory sync.

Global Consumer Electronics Brand (System Integration): Connected customer support, Salesforce, HubSpot, RingCentral voice, and ERP/RMA workflows, reducing manual return processing from days to minutes.

180+ GitHub Repositories & Flagship Live Systems: Maintained 180+ open-source GitHub repositories alongside 5 flagship live systems—888 StockBot 2.0 (equity valuation), 888 StockQuant (time-series forecasting), 888news (automated tech intelligence & MCP), DAVID888 Daily (automated audio podcast), and 333 Qi Men Dun Jia (calendar calculation engine).
Available for: 12-Month Technical Advisor Retainers, Full-Time CTO / VP of Engineering roles, and Technical Due Diligence. No gambling, Ponzi, or illegal projects.
